item.title: Broadening the PSM Perspective: Lessons from Underrepresented Regions
item.content:encoded:
This special issue seeks to expand the purchasing and supply management literature by incorporating perspectives and insights from regions that have been historically underrepresented in scholarly discourse. The call invites research that challenges conventional wisdom by drawing on experiences and contexts from diverse geographical areas.
